Class StyledProperty<T>

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.style.StyledProperty<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of the property value
public final class StyledProperty<T> extends Object
A property value that can be set programmatically or resolved from a style source.

StyledProperty encapsulates the common pattern of having a property that can be:

  1. Set explicitly via a fluent API (programmatic value)
  2. Resolved from a styling system
  3. Falling back to a default value

Resolution order: programmatic → resolver → default

Usage in toolkit elements:

public class MyElement extends StyledElement<MyElement> {
    private final StyledProperty<Color> borderColor =
        styledProperty(StandardPropertyKeys.BORDER_COLOR, Color.WHITE);

    public MyElement borderColor(Color color) {
        borderColor.set(color);
        return this;
    }

    protected void renderContent(Frame frame, Rect area, RenderContext context) {
        Color color = borderColor.resolve();
        // render with color...
    }
}

Usage in standalone widgets:

StyledProperty<Color> color = StyledProperty.of(BORDER_COLOR, Color.WHITE);
color.resolve(resolver);

    • of

      public static <T> StyledProperty<T> of(PropertyKey<T> key)
      Creates a styled property with the given key and no default value.

      The returned property is unbound - resolve() will use an empty resolver. Use of(PropertyKey, Object, Supplier) to create a bound property.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the property value
      Parameters:
      key - the property key for resolution
      Returns:
      the styled property

    • of

      public static <T> StyledProperty<T> of(PropertyKey<T> key, T defaultValue)
      Creates a styled property with the given key and default value.

      The returned property is unbound - resolve() will use an empty resolver. Use of(PropertyKey, Object, Supplier) to create a bound property.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the property value
      Parameters:
      key - the property key for resolution
      defaultValue - the default value when neither programmatic nor resolved value is available
      Returns:
      the styled property

    • of

      public static <T> StyledProperty<T> of(PropertyKey<T> key, T defaultValue, Supplier<StylePropertyResolver> resolverSupplier)
      Creates a styled property bound to a resolver supplier.

      When resolve() is called, it will use the resolver from the supplier. This is typically used by elements that maintain a current resolver during rendering.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the property value
      Parameters:
      key - the property key for resolution
      defaultValue - the default value when neither programmatic nor resolved value is available
      resolverSupplier - supplies the property resolver to use during resolution
      Returns:
      the styled property

    • resolve

      public T resolve(StylePropertyResolver resolver)
      Resolves the effective value for this property.

      Resolution order:

      1. Programmatic value (if set via set(T))
      2. Resolved value from the resolver
      3. Default value
      Parameters:
      resolver - the property resolver to use for resolution
      Returns:
      the resolved value, or null if no value is available

    • resolve

      public T resolve()
      Resolves the effective value using the bound resolver, or empty if unbound.

      For bound properties (created with a resolver supplier), this uses the current resolver from the supplier. For unbound properties, this is equivalent to returning the programmatic value or default.

      Returns:
      the resolved value, or null if no value is available
